sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pending_mutations" ("operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "family_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "mutation_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "base_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload_digest" TEXT NOT NULL, "protocol_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at_us" INTEGER NOT NULL, "next_attempt_at_us" INTEGER NULL, "lease_expires_at_us" INTEGER NULL, "accepted_revision" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("operation_id"), CHECK (mutation_kind IN ('upsert', 'delete')), CHECK (base_revision >= 0), CHECK (json_valid(payload_json)), CHECK (length(payload_digest) = 64), CHECK (protocol_version > 0), CHECK (state IN ('pending', 'in_flight', 'conflicted', 'rejected', 'acknowledged')), CHECK (attempts >= 0), CHECK (accepted_revision IS NULL OR accepted_revision > 0), CHECK (state <> 'acknowledged' OR accepted_revision IS NOT NULL));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_checkpoints" ("family_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "authorization_epoch" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "updated_at_us" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("family_id"), CHECK (last_sequence >= 0), CHECK (authorization_epoch >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_conflicts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES pending_mutations (operation_id), "server_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "server_snapshot_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "detected_at_us" INTEGER NOT NULL, "resolved_at_us" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (server_revision > 0), CHECK (json_valid(server_snapshot_json)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "family_spaces" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'INR', "created_at_us" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (mode IN ('offline', 'cloud')), CHECK (currency = 'INR')) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "family_members" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "family_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES family_spaces (id), "auth_user_id" TEXT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "relationship" TEXT NOT NULL, "role" TEXT NOT NULL, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_at_us" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE (family_id, id), CHECK (role IN ('administrator', 'member')), CHECK (revision > 0)) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "vault_devices" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "family_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "member_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_us" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE (family_id, id, member_id), FOREIGN KEY (family_id, member_id) REFERENCES family_members(family_id, id), CHECK (state IN ('enrolled', 'revoked', 'pending'))) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ledger_accounts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "family_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES family_spaces (id), "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_us" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_us" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at_us" INTEGER NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "subtype" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'INR', "system_account" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("system_account" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE (family_id, id), CHECK (revision > 0), CHECK (updated_at_us >= created_at_us), CHECK (deleted_at_us IS NULL OR deleted_at_us >= created_at_us), FOREIGN KEY (family_id, created_by) REFERENCES family_members(family_id, id), FOREIGN KEY (family_id, updated_by) REFERENCES family_members(family_id, id), CHECK (kind IN ('asset', 'liability', 'equity', 'income', 'expense')), CHECK (currency = 'INR')) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ledger_journals" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "family_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES family_spaces (id), "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_us" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_us" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at_us" INTEGER NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurred_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'INR', "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft', "reverses_id" TEXT NULL, "business_id" TEXT NULL, "related_entity_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE (family_id, id), CHECK (revision > 0), CHECK (updated_at_us >= created_at_us), CHECK (deleted_at_us IS NULL OR deleted_at_us >= created_at_us), FOREIGN KEY (family_id, created_by) REFERENCES family_members(family_id, id), FOREIGN KEY (family_id, updated_by) REFERENCES family_members(family_id, id), CHECK (kind IN ('income', 'expense', 'transfer', 'opening', 'adjustment', 'reversal', 'repayment', 'business')), CHECK (currency = 'INR'), CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'posted')), CHECK (date(occurred_on) IS NOT NULL AND date(occurred_on) = occurred_on AND length(occurred_on) = 10), FOREIGN KEY (family_id, reverses_id) REFERENCES ledger_journals(family_id, id), UNIQUE (reverses_id)) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ledger_postings" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "family_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "journal_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), FOREIGN KEY (family_id, journal_id) REFERENCES ledger_journals(family_id, id), FOREIGN KEY (family_id, account_id) REFERENCES ledger_accounts(family_id, id), UNIQUE (journal_id, position), CHECK (amount_minor <> 0), CHECK (position >= 0)) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_audit_events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "family_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "actor_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "action" TEXT NOT NULL, "before_json" TEXT NULL, "after_json" TEXT NULL, "created_at_us" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), FOREIGN KEY (family_id, device_id, actor_id) REFERENCES vault_devices(family_id, id, member_id), UNIQUE (family_id, operation_id, entity_type, entity_id), CHECK (before_json IS NULL OR json_valid(before_json)), CHECK (after_json IS NULL OR json_valid(after_json))) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "monthly_budgets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "family_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES family_spaces (id), "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_us" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_us" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at_us" INTEGER NULL, "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "month" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE (family_id, id), CHECK (revision > 0), CHECK (updated_at_us >= created_at_us), CHECK (deleted_at_us IS NULL OR deleted_at_us >= created_at_us), FOREIGN KEY (family_id, created_by) REFERENCES family_members(family_id, id), FOREIGN KEY (family_id, updated_by) REFERENCES family_members(family_id, id), FOREIGN KEY (family_id, account_id) REFERENCES ledger_accounts(family_id, id), CHECK (amount_minor >= 0), CHECK (length(month) = 7 AND date(month || '-01') IS NOT NULL)) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reconciliation_checks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "family_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES family_spaces (id), "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_us" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_us" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at_us" INTEGER NULL, "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "statement_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "statement_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ledger_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE (family_id, id), CHECK (revision > 0), CHECK (updated_at_us >= created_at_us), CHECK (deleted_at_us IS NULL OR deleted_at_us >= created_at_us), FOREIGN KEY (family_id, created_by) REFERENCES family_members(family_id, id), FOREIGN KEY (family_id, updated_by) REFERENCES family_members(family_id, id), FOREIGN KEY (family_id, account_id) REFERENCES ledger_accounts(family_id, id), CHECK (date(statement_date) IS NOT NULL AND date(statement_date) = statement_date)) STRICT;
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "vault_preferences" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key")) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX pending_mutations_retry ON pending_mutations (state, next_attempt_at_us)
